name: adhd-mods
description: Claude Code mods for ADHD brains, by Inspired Spitfire: a focus timer and a body double.

plugins.name: focus-timer
plugins.description: A focus timer above the prompt: /timer 25 write the essay, then pause, +5, break, stop. Ends with a toast, a voice, and a line with some personality.

plugins.name: body-double
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat: the task you are on, the focus timer, and what you finished today. Every focus block that runs out lands on the list.
